name: dsh-survey
description: Questionnaire-style survey plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the do_a_survey tool asks 1-10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no/compare/open types) in four presentation modes (compact/inline/overlay/grid), with per-question skip, full Markdown & color rendering, and a two-column recap after submit. Bundle form resident in the Web profile; companion skill ships a dynamic-plugin fallback recipe.
